# IMMUNIZATION OF PATIENTS AGE 27-49 YEARS

See immunization information pages located at the bottom of this page for other indications, contraindications, and one-time dose orders to listed vaccines.

Patient vaccine history

CDC Recommended Adult Immunization Schedule

# Specific vaccine orders for patients age 27-49 years:

[Haemophilus influenza type b: indicated in asplenia, those undergoing](haemophilus-influenza-type-b-vaccine-information)
splenectomy and HSCT patients. Refer to specific immunization recommendations for patients with these indications or refer to the Haemophilus influenza type b vaccine information menu below.

Hepatitis A: 2 dose series, for those who want protection, or w/additional risk
factor or another indication.

Hepatitis A/B: 3 dose series, for those who want protection, or w/additional
risk factor or another indication.

Hepatitis B: 3 dose series.
Hepatitis B high dose: 4 dose series, for those on hemodyalisis.

Herpes zoster: not indicated.

Human papillomavirus: 3 dose series for age 27-45yrs based on shared clinical
decision making.

[Influenza: one dose annually.](flu-seasonal-influenza)

Measles, mumps, and rubella: one dose.

Measles, mumps, and rubella: 2 dose series, for those w/additional risk factor
or another indication.

[Meningococcal A, C, W and Y: indicated in asplenia, HIV, complement deficiency](meningococcal-conjugate-vaccine-information)
or inhibitor use, travel to endemic countries, microbiologists, and college students. Refer to specific immunization recommendations for asplenia and HIV or refer to the Meningococcal A, C, W and Y vaccine information menu below.

Meningococcal B: 2 dose for those w/additional risk factor or another
indication.

[Pneumococcal: for those w/additional risk factor or another indication. Refer to](pneumococcal-vaccine-information)
specific immunization recommendations for patients with these indications or refer to the Pneumococcal vaccine information menus below.

Tetanus, diphtheria and pertussis: 3 dose primary series, booster every 10yrs.

Varicella: 2 dose series for those born 1980 or later.
